work.author: PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA
work.description: The act mourns Archbishop Affre of Paris and provides for the see. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF5492-5493 reads: HABITA 1N CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE XI SEPTEMRRIS ANNI NDCCCXLVIIH. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
